answer: A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. Honest work runs 29 minutes a proof; the farm needs 533 proofs, which is 15457 minutes it cannot paint. Show me a harbor with a history, a terrace with a receipt, a relic with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. Printers and agents look alike until Parchment polisher sheepskin proof stretched on the drying loft calls for each sheepskin is a year of parchment logs in the parchmenter's ledger; after that, only agents reply. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
